subject: HIPAA compliance add-ons: implementation fee vs recurring credit — clarification
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@healthsync.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify HIPAA add-on pricing (implementation fee vs recurring credit)

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the latency and the audit-log retention options. Before we move to procurement, two questions came up from our finance and security teams:

1) You show an "implementation" line for HIPAA onboarding in the quote. Can that be converted into a recurring credit applied against monthly committed spend instead? If so, over what period would that amortize?

2) For HSM seats: we need both a capex-style seat fee and a run-rate per-token number to compare to our internal TCO model. Can you send the breakdown and an example amortization (12/24/36 months)?

We attached our audit-evidence checklist for your reference (see attachment). Also looping in procurement in case they want to pick up PO formatting.

Maya
Maya Patel
VP Product Operations, HealthSync
maya@healthsync.com

--- attachment: HIPAA-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify HIPAA add-on pricing (implementation fee vs recurring credit)

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the checklist. Short answers up front: yes, we can convert the one-time implementation fee into a recurring credit; and we can provide a clear HSM-seat amortization table. Details below.

Implementation fee -> recurring credit options:
- Option A: Full implementation credit amortized over 12 months (equal monthly credits applied against committed usage).
- Option B: 50% upfront implementation fee + remaining 50% amortized over 24 months.
- Option C: No upfront fee, implementation capitalized and amortized over 36 months (requires 12-month minimum committed spend to enable).

Tradeoffs to call out: amortizing over longer periods lowers near-term cash outlay for you but increases total committed spend required for us to protect capacity (we use that to qualify Dedicated/GTM discounts).

HSM seats:
- We offer per-seat annual pricing and an equivalent per-token run-rate for high-throughput workloads. Attached "HSM-seat-pricing.xlsx" shows an example for 12/24/36-month amortizations with three throughput scenarios.

Next steps I propose: Ben (cc'd) will confirm the maximum concession we can approve from deal desk; Laura can confirm if Finance will accept 24 vs 36 month amortization for revenue recognition. If you prefer, we can draft a small amendment that shows the chosen path and credit schedule — I can attach a SOW draft for legal.

I'll attach the SOW-draft.docx and the HSM spreadsheet.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.com

--- attachments: SOW-draft.docx (docx, 120 KB); HSM-seat-pricing.xlsx (xlsx, 85 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Clarify HIPAA add-on pricing (implementation fee vs recurring credit)

Lukas / Laura — quick internal note. HealthSync is mid-market but moving fast; they asked for a concession path we discussed in the playbook. My recommendation:

- Approve Option B (50% upfront + 24mo amortization) for implementation credit.
- Offer a 12% effective discount on HSM seats if they commit to a 24-month amortization and a minimum 12-month committed spend of $50k/month.

Reasoning: gives them near-term relief while preserving our revenue runway. If Laura signs off on revenue recognition and legal is OK with amendment language, we can present this as a clean two-line amendment (implementation credit schedule + HSM-seat table).

If procurement pushes for full 36-month amortization we can ask for an additional capacity commit or a small non-refundable on-prem support fee.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Deals, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Maya Patel <maya@healthsync.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify HIPAA add-on pricing (implementation fee vs recurring credit)

Thanks — Option B (50% upfront + 24 mo amortization) looks reasonable to us. A couple of clarifying items from Procurement:

1) Can the SOW amendment call the amortized amount a "monthly credit" rather than being labeled as a rebate? Procurement prefers credit language for easier mapping to our chargebacks.
2) On HSM seats: if we take the 12% effective discount, can you confirm the per-seat annual cost after discount and show the per-token run-rate for our P95 call volume?

I'll have Procurement draft the PO once we receive the amendment language and final table.

On attachments: procurement asked for a short evidence list for SOC2/HIPAA deliverables we can expect during onboarding — your checklist was helpful but could you itemize expected artifacts and delivery timing (e.g., access to audit logs, attestation docs) in the amendment?

Best,
Maya

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Clarify HIPAA add-on pricing (implementation fee vs recurring credit)

All — quick follow-up to confirm approvals and next steps before we send formal amendment:

1) Revenue recognition: Finance is OK with Option B (50/50 + 24mo amortization) provided we document the credit schedule in the amendment and that monthly credits are applied against committed usage lines (not as a one-off rebate).
2) Legal/Security: Dev has confirmed the evidence artifacts list he expects during onboarding; please see the short bullets below that I ask you include in the SOW amendment.

Evidence/artifacts to include in amendment (deliverable + timing):
- Access to 30 days of audit log forwarding to HealthSync S3 (within 7 business days of go-live).
- HSM attestation and configuration report (within 15 business days of go-live).
- Monthly red-team runbook and incident postmortem template (first delivery within 30 days).
- HIPAA onboarding checklist sign-off (jointly executed during kick-off).

3) HSM pricing: Ben — please finalize the 12% discounted per-seat annual line and the equivalent per-token run-rate for the P95 profile. Dev, can you sanity-check that the configuration we propose supports HealthSync's expected throughput?

Once those items are in the doc, Lukas please send the amendment to Maya and Procurement for signature.

Laura Bennett
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
